text:
A special Pauper tournament is this week, where every deck has a fighting chance!

Format: 60-card decks + 15 card sideboard. Only commons allowed.

Official Pauper banlist: https://scryfall.com/search?q=banned%3Apauper

Prizes: Guaranteed prizes for all participants, extra for winners

If you don’t have a deck, we have prebuilt ones you can borrow. Players will compete in separate groups for experienced and newer participants. Come join the fun and test your skills!
